firebase.js is a bundle of the Firebase JavaScript SDK v12.19.0
(packages: firebase/app, firebase/auth, firebase/firestore), built with esbuild:

  npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=SBFirebase

The Firebase JavaScript SDK is Copyright Google LLC and licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
The individual license notices are preserved at the end of firebase.js.
